text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> GPU_MEM_PRESSURE on pool west2a-rtg. severity=P2. 35% of GPUs reporting sustained vmem pressure and frequent kvcache evictions. pager: <https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-west2a|INC-2026-west2a> :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Pager routed to on-call rotation (maria_oncall). Auto-ack window elapsed, please ack or escalate.

maria_oncall: acked. I'm on it, starting quick triage. anyone seeing customer spikes?

kevin_sre: seeing increased 5xx and latency on inference-west2a routes, particularly route /v1/generate-small. pushing fallback already?

maria_oncall: yes, enabled route fallback to model-quantized-1.3 (lower mem) for west2a. will drain noisy pods.

anjali_prodeng: customer impact: ClearMap-prod showing ~20% request failures over last 5m, and ClearVision (non-prod) noisy retry loops. Triage: high mem usage on these pods.

maria_oncall: grabbing logs from the worst node now.

maria_oncall: logs from gpu-12-west2a:
```
[2026-03-15T10:04:23Z] CUDA_ERROR: out of memory when allocating 1342177280 bytes
stack: runtime::alloc at alloc.cpp:123
kvcache: evictions/sec=420, hit_rate=0.12
model: opt-6.7 q8_0 working set growth +40% over baseline
```

kevin_sre: that looks like a kvcache churn problem triggering OOM on large models. possible recent traffic pattern causing long prefixes. Can we enable prefix-KV-ttl=30s for the route?

maria_oncall: applying quick config change to reduce KV retention on route /v1/generate-small.

maria_oncall: ran: `redwoodctl routes update /v1/generate-small --kv-ttl 30s --batching=max-8`

incident-bot: config change deployed to west2a (config-id: cfg-3579).

kevin_sre: still seeing mem pressure on gpu-09 and gpu-12. I'm going to preempt the largest consumers (evict pods with ephemeral tag).

maria_oncall: starting controlled evict on gpu-12 and gpu-09. runbook: drain -> wait 60s -> observe.

kevin_sre: `kubectl drain gpu-12-west2a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` initiated.

anjali_prodeng: pinging ClearMap SEs to let them know we have fallbacks and are evacuating noisy hosts.

maria_oncall: after first evict, kvcache evictions dropped to 120/s, mem pressure eased on gpu-12. latency for fallback route stable.

kevin_sre: but gpu-09 still shows allocation failures. I recommend spinning up 4 hot-standby nodes in west2a (dedicated) and rerouting lower-priority workloads there.

maria_oncall: scaling up dedicated pool west2a-burst +4 nodes (request sent to autoscaler).

incident-bot: autoscaler accepted scale request id=scale-9987, ETA ~2m.

dave_support: ClearMap reports some requests are still timing out, they asked for estimate.

maria_oncall: ETA for visible improvement ~3-4m after scale. told ClearMap. They acknowledged.

kevin_sre: autoscaler up. new nodes joined: gpu-21-west2a, gpu-22-west2a, gpu-23-west2a, gpu-24-west2a. Rerouting background batch jobs -> west2a-burst.

maria_oncall: routing change applied. Monitoring request success % and tail latencies.

anjali_prodeng: customer ClearMap success rate climbing: 85% -> 98% in last 3m. Good.

kevin_sre: note: we still had some CUDA_ALLOC_FAILURE traces on gpu-09 earlier that we'll want to follow-up on (possible driver or fragmentation).

maria_oncall: marking incident as mitigated for now. leaving pager open for 30m observation window.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-west2a acknowledged and marked mitigated (monitoring window active).

kevin_sre: adding follow-up work: 1) investigate kvcache eviction thresholds and auto-ttl heuristics, 2) check driver upgrade history on gpu-09, 3) run model memory regression test for opt-6.7 on west2a waveform.

anjali_prodeng: I'll coordinate customer post-incident notes and collect example failing requests for QA.

maria_oncall: handing off to kevin_sre for next 30m watch. @kevin_sre you're primary, I'll stay available.

kevin_sre: taking handoff. will open quick incident note and assign tasks. tagging @dave_support for customer comms.

maria_oncall: thanks team. if pressure returns we escalate to P1 and page infra-eng. otherwise, we'll create a short follow-up doc and retrospective. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: thread closed for new automated actions, manual follow-ups remain.
